capabilities: Render 17 chart types (bar, line, scatter, sankey, etc.) from a code fence with CSV or a Markdown table
Draw charts in Reading view and Live Preview with colors derived from the active theme's CSS variables
Keep the block as plain text that still reads as a table elsewhere in any Markdown app
Show a caption and full data table under each rendered figure
Display invalid blocks as a table plus one line explaining what to fix
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory at time of writing; the README gives BRAT and manual installation steps for use before listing. Full block format, chart types, and examples live at markvis.js.org rather than in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render tabular data in a note as a chart; users must rely on external tools or complex setups.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a thin host for markvis, which defines the block and draws the SVG.

summary: Chart renderer that draws 17 chart types in notes from a code block of header lines plus CSV or a Markdown table, in theme colors with no network.
